comment: Written for gEdit (synthetic, not for a machine); see README.md here.
description: Siemens two channels: channel 1 waits on mark 1 in a loop closed by IF R1<3 GOTOB LOOP1; channel 2 writes mark 1 three times. The jump lines read the label, so the count was not checked; with the flow the conditional backward jump is opaque around the wait and the count is still not checked.
